name: git-relay
description: Automatic Git worktree coordination and branch monitoring for Codex and OpenCode.

interface.longDescription: Automatically coordinate Codex and OpenCode sessions, receive changes and messages, and inspect branches. The shared daemon follows client lifetime; automatic branch synchronization is unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Show GitRelay status and participating sessions.
Monitor branch changes with automatic synchronization disabled.
Explain GitRelay commands and safe branch synchronization.
